phases.description: Initialize Node.js project, install Express, and configure the basic project structure and server setup.
Develop NotesController to handle creation, listing, and deletion of notes utilizing the InMemoryNotesStorage component for data management.
Write and execute tests to ensure all API endpoints function as expected and handle edge cases such as non-existent note deletions.
Prepare the environment for deploying the application, including ensuring all configurations are in place and tuning server settings for initial deployment.

top_risks.mitigation: Document the in-memory storage limitation and suggest regular exports.
Clarify in the documentation that the system is designed for small personal use cases, not scalability.

estimate.summary: The overall effort level is moderate due to the straightforward functionality and use of in-memory storage. The biggest cost driver is the implementation of core logic and API endpoint handling. A key assumption is that in-memory storage will be acceptable for the intended use case.
